Front page

GTA VI unlocks at midnight, local time, on Thursday

A rolling release: every region starts at its own midnight, so the first players are in New Zealand and the last in Hawaii.

Headlines come from Google News and link to the outlet that wrote them. Drops are written by the desk and carry a label: Official, Reported, Expected or Crew.

Greetings fromSix regions. One state.

Rockstar named six regions of Leonida. Next to each one: the real place fans think it is based on. Guides for each region land here after launch.

01Fan reading: Miami

The city ofVice City

Neon, nightlife and money. The heart of the map.

 02Fan reading: Florida Keys

Leonida Keys
